sql: INFO FOR TABLE article; INFO FOR TABLE passage; INFO FOR TABLE brief; INFO FOR TABLE factbox;

SELECT id, status FROM article WHERE string::contains(body, 'quantum') OR string::contains(title,'quantum'); SELECT id, kind, article FROM brief WHERE string::contains(text,'quantum'); SELECT id, heading FROM factbox WHERE string::contains(body,'quantum') OR string::contains(heading,'quantum'); SELECT id, parent FROM passage WHERE string::contains(content,'quantum');
SELECT status, desk, title FROM article WHERE status IN ['c_04','c_11','c_23'] GROUP BY status LIMIT 20; SELECT id, status, desk, title FROM article;
